title: The Man behind Stable Diffusion
summary: Yannic Kilcher interviews Emad Mostaque, founder of Stability AI, about the company's funding, its mission, and the release of Stable Diffusion. Topics include access to compute, handling harmful outputs, and avoiding the corrupting influence of profit.
why: Commenters cite it during Stable Diffusion release debates as a source for Mostaque's vision and Stability's principles.
topic: stability ai and open generative models

quote.text: This interview is a good overview of the principles behind their approach
